questions.original: salud es soltar estrés en tu badajo
questions.issue: 'badajo' = bell clapper, cock slang; en 'clapper' keeps double meaning only partly.

questions.original: te meto mano en un banco so-be-te-o
questions.issue: 'banco' (bank / bench) + 'sobeteo' (groping) vs 'sabotaje' rhyme; en/eu keep the sound-split but lose the exact rhyme.

questions.original: patita de cabra en tu cintura
questions.issue: 'patita de cabra' could be a literal goat hoof (heel/leg) or a sex-position/strap image; translated literally.

questions.original: por mi lesbiana me caigo para atras
questions.issue: 'por mi lesbiana' reads like an oath ('por mi madre') with 'lesbiana' in place of mother; translated as 'I swear on my lesbian' (en) / 'nire bollerarengatik' (eu); unsure.

questions.original: aprendi a volar como carrero blanco
questions.issue: 'carrero blanco' = Franco's PM blown up by ETA in 1973; kept the name, the allusion is lost for non-Spanish audiences.
'alunizaje' = ram-raid (car smashed into shop window); en 'ram-raid style', eu keeps 'alunizajeen' (no good Basque term).
'gripa' unclear (flu? 'agripa'? from 'agarrar'/'gripar' = to seize up); translated as 'grip it', uncertain.
'leche' = milk/cum; translated as cum (en) and 'esnea' (eu, also milk/cum).

questions.original: so cut the washing - the green and the pink
questions.issue: Source 'cut the washing' = stop greenwashing/pinkwashing; es/eu spell it out.

questions.original: it's genocide, i can't erase your face
questions.issue: 'I can't erase your face' ambiguous (victims' faces? Palestinian faces?); translated literally.

questions.original: we take it to the stage and connect the struggles
questions.issue: 'montemos un pollo' = idiom for 'raise hell'; chose that for 'make a stink'.
